question: In which year was the National Rural Health Mission launched in India to provide accessible, affordable and quality health care to the rural population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2005**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Rural Health Mission (NRHM) was launched by the Government of India in **April 2005**.
 
• It aimed to provide accessible, affordable, and quality healthcare services to the rural population, especially vulnerable groups.
 
• NRHM focused on improving maternal and child health, reducing mortality rates, and combating communicable and non-communicable diseases.
 
• The mission emphasized strengthening the public health system, including infrastructure, human resources, and service delivery in rural areas.
 
• NRHM was later subsumed under the **National Health Mission (NHM)** in 2013, which expanded its scope to urban areas as well.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key Objectives of NRHM:**

 
 
• Reduce infant mortality rate (IMR) and maternal mortality rate (MMR).
 
• Ensure universal access to public health services such as immunization, nutrition, sanitation, and safe drinking water.
 
• Promote population stabilization and address gender and social disparities in healthcare.
 
 
 
• **Accredited Social Health Activists (ASHAs):**
 
 
• NRHM introduced ASHAs, community health workers, to act as a link between rural communities and healthcare systems.
 
• ASHAs are trained to provide basic healthcare services and facilitate awareness on health and hygiene.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure Development:**
 
 
• Under NRHM, efforts were made to upgrade rural healthcare facilities such as Sub-Centres, Primary Health Centres (PHCs), and Community Health Centres (CHCs).
 
• Mobile Medical Units (MMUs) were also introduced to provide healthcare services in remote areas.
 
 
 
• **National Health Mission (NHM):**
 
 
• NHM, launched in 2013, combined NRHM with the National Urban Health Mission (NUHM).
 
• NHM expanded its focus to urban health challenges while continuing NRHM's objectives in rural areas.
